newsitem.title: FRANCE: Gunmen blow up Algerian landmark fountain.
newsitem.headline: Gunmen blow up Algerian landmark fountain.

text.p: Gunmen suspected to be Moslem guerrillas on Tuesday blew up a landmark fountain in the eastern Algerian town of Setif, Algerian state-run radio said.
The explosion ripped through the century-old fountain in the centre of Setif, 240 km (150 miles) from Algiers, destroying the landmark widely known as Ain al Faouara (source which gushes), it said.
Many Algerians refer to Setif as Ain al Faouara, and its destruction prompted an emergency meeting by the local governor and specialists on rebuilding it within a week.
"I feel a deep sorrow as if I had lost a loved one," the radio quoted one resident of the town, which has been spared much of Algeria's violence, as saying.
